label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: param from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to response.sendRedirect(param) sink. While Referer header guards the entry point, attacker can control both Referer (to pass guard) and BenchmarkTest parameter (to inject malicious redirect path). Resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input reaching sendRedirect URL parameter.

evidence.note: User input from request.getParameter flows to sendRedirect sink without sanitization
